answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 59925 Country: India Title: taweez Question: (1) Can we wear tawiz around neck and hand (Muslim and non-Muslim)? (2) Some Hazrats do not write Quranic verses and Hadith. They mention some numbers. Is such tawiz allowable? (3) Can we get some hadiya after giving taweez? Is it permissible? (4) Can we perform maulud in masjid and new house inauguration? After we get hadiya for maulud? Answer ID: 59925 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 596/561/SN=08/1436) (1) Yes, you may wear it provided you do not consider the tawiz effective in itself and the tawiz does not carry any word of kufr and shirk. (Abu Dawud, Hadith No. 3893) (2) It is lawful. (3) You may take it provided you do not deceive people. However it is not good for the Ulama as well as respected people to take money in return of giving tawiz. (4) No, it is not lawful to accept hadiya or take compensation after reading the prevalent maulud. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
